kurz: Drain pasta 1–2 minutes early and finish it in the sauce with a little pasta water: it takes on flavour and the sauce clings.
bild_im_kopf: Like bread dipped in soup: it takes up whatever is around it last.
was_passiert: In the last minutes the [[w-pasta|pasta]] still absorbs liquid. If it cooks in the sauce rather than the water, it soaks up sauce rather than water. At the same time it releases starch which, together with the pasta water, binds fat and liquid into a silky sauce.
warum_wichtig: Drained pasta with sauce spooned on top stays bland, and the sauce slides off.
faustregeln: Sauce too thick? More pasta water. Too thin? Keep tossing, the starch will bind it.
schritte: Save a cup of pasta water.
Drain the pasta 1–2 minutes before the packet time.
Add it to the hot sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Toss and cook for 1–2 minutes until the sauce is glossy and clings to the pasta.
